source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey,

Your clips are approved and ready to go live. Here is exactly how to post each one:

**POSTING INSTRUCTIONS**

1\. Upload the clip as a Reel on your assigned Instagram account
2\. Use this caption for every clip:

*Follow @tonalexina for more 🔥*

3\. Add these hashtags to every post:
#teyronalexina #personaldevelopment #entrepreneurship #mindset #motivation #selfimprovement #businessadvice #successmindset #growthmindset #ecommerce

4\. Tag @tonalexina in the post itself — not just the caption
5\. Post at peak hours — between 6pm and 9pm for best reach
6\. Once posted — update the card in Notion with the Date Posted and the Instagram link to the reel

Post all 3 clips — space them out, one per day for maximum reach. Do not post all three on the same day.

Any questions — message me immediately.

Cleavon

value_updates.batch_spacing_rule: do not post all three clips on the same day

routing_warnings.description: The message authorizes one approved clip to be published but does not change the daily cadence or peak-hour window.
The Reel link evidences publication, but it does not establish compliance with the posting schedule.
The requirement for at least 10 approved videos to be posted changes publication volume, not posting cadence or timing.
